title: SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00838v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains a large language model (LLM) to act over long, multi-step interactions. However, a single localized error can cause task failure, while trajectory-level rewards provide limited guidance for assigning credit to individual decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce Segment-level Hindsight Advantage Reweighting for Policy Optimization (SHARPO), a credit-assignment mechanism that refines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the level of environment-facing segments. Inspired by the existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) method, SHARPO computes teacher-student log-probability gaps within each segment and uses the resulting signal to compute a bounded multiplier on the GRPO advantage. This multiplier is shared by all tokens within the segment, allowing credit to vary across different segments. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SHARPO outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and We

translated_title: SHARPO：面向智能体强化学习的分段级信用分配方法
translated_abstract: 智能体强化学习（RL）训练大语言模型（LLM）在长程、多步的交互中执行动作。然而，单个局部错误就可能导致任务失败，而轨迹级奖励对于如何将功劳分配给各个单独决策所提供的指导十分有限。为解决这一局限，我们提出了面向策略优化的分段级事后优势重加权方法（SHARPO），这是一种在面向环境交互的分段层面上对组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行精细化的信用分配机制。受现有在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）方法的启发，SHARPO 在每个分段内计算教师-学生模型之间的对数概率差，并利用由此产生的信号计算作用于 GRPO 优势的一个有界乘数。该乘数由分段内的所有词元共享，从而使信用分配能够在不同分段之间有所差异。基于 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 模型，SHARPO 在 ALFWorld 和 We（摘要在此处截断）等基准上超越了现有基线。
tldr: SHARPO 提出了一种分段级信用分配机制，通过在每个分段内计算教师-学生对数概率差来生成有界乘数以重加权 GRPO 优势，使智能体强化学习中不同分段获得差异化的信用分配，从而在多步交互任务上超越现有基线。
en_tdlr: SHARPO introduces segment-level credit assignment for agentic reinforcement learning by computing teacher-student log-probability gaps within each segment to derive a bounded multiplier on the GRPO advantage, allowing credit to vary across segments and outperforming existing baselines.
